alerts._note: Phone care event alerts (phonecare/PhoneAlerts). Each type is OFF until the user switches it on. Quiet hours come from triggers.quietHours.

money._note: senders: SMS sender ids trusted as Mobile Money (compared without case, spaces or punctuation). apps: MoMo apps' own notifications (a trailing * = package prefix). extraPatterns: more 'received' regexes (case-insensitive; group 1 = amount, optional group 2 = payer), added to the code defaults. extraMistakePatterns: more 'sent by mistake' fraud phrasings.
money._senders_note: No bare 'MoMo': people save their MoMo agent's number under that name. When READ_SMS is granted the SMS's real sender address is checked, not the contact name. Telecel Cash's real sender id is unverified.
